criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use a steep isometric projection with matching diagonal ground axes.
Both frame a broad industrial-city network from a fixed elevated view.
different: The CANDIDATE is slightly more top-down and shows a wider world area.
The CANDIDATE exposes its tiled ground geometry more strongly.

evidence.observation: Elevated isometric framing shows roofs, short facades, and two dominant diagonal axes.
The same elevated diagonal projection is visible, with somewhat wider and more top-down framing.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both concentrate industry on the left and dense housing on the right.
Roads, facilities, and small buildings occupy most of each visible map.
different: The CANDIDATE has larger open gridded parcels through the center.
REFERENCE mass is more continuously distributed, while CANDIDATE housing forms heavier edge clusters.

evidence.observation: Industry, roads, rubble, and housing form a nearly continuous occupied field.
Comparable industrial and residential density surrounds visibly broader open central parcels.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both rivers are dark blue, recessed, rocky-banked channels with an S-like bend.
Each channel is integrated with a bridge or road crossing.
different: The CANDIDATE channel is a more prominent central-left S curve.
REFERENCE shows a longer diagonal channel context and different crossing placement.

evidence.observation: A narrow dark channel winds diagonally through deep textured banks and transport crossings.
A broad central-left S-shaped channel has rocky banks and a conspicuous bridge attachment.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Plants and substations remain several times larger than nearby houses.
Transmission towers have comparable height and footprint relative to roads and buildings.
different: CANDIDATE map silhouettes are slightly smaller because of the wider framing.
Its large residential blocks and hospital create somewhat stronger landmark contrast.

evidence.observation: Factories, substations, towers, and small houses follow a consistent stepped size hierarchy.
The same relative hierarchy is present, though the wider view reduces most map silhouettes.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use blackened metal, charcoal soil, worn concrete, and sparse amber illumination.
World and interface details share a cohesive distressed industrial finish.
different: REFERENCE has slightly stronger blue glow and brighter metallic edge highlights.
CANDIDATE terrain is flatter and more uniformly gray in its midtones.

evidence.observation: Dense rubble, oxidized structures, warm windows, and luminous conductors create a richly contrasted dark surface.
Matching distressed masonry and metal textures appear with quieter highlights and flatter midtones.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both clearly separate cyan energized conductors from amber dashed planned routes.
Parallel conductors visibly follow tower chains between plants and populated areas.
different: REFERENCE cyan routes have a stronger bloom and smoother continuous sweep.
CANDIDATE routes use sharper bends, and some tower attachments read less directly.

evidence.observation: Bright parallel cyan lines connect blue-lit towers and substations with strong route continuity.
Amber towers and dashed conductors form a distinct planned lower circuit.
Triple cyan conductors and pale towers form a readable energized route across the upper map.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use heavy riveted chrome across a segmented top bar, left kit, and right inspector.
Their overlay proportions and cyan-versus-amber hierarchy are closely matched.
different: CANDIDATE relies on smaller text and denser status labels.
Its inspector contains a larger underused dark section than the compact REFERENCE inspector.

evidence.observation: A compact riveted top bar presents currency, power, day, and pause status in large type.
A nearly identical segmented chrome bar uses denser, smaller Korean status text.
Four large icon cards form a strongly integrated vertical construction kit.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Both use a centered four-cell bottom strip with the same footprint and industrial chrome.
Both highlight the active cell in cyan while keeping inactive cells dark.
different: REFERENCE cells show playback controls and speed values.
CANDIDATE cells show completion, current progress, result, and next-stage states.

evidence.observation: A centered four-part playback strip has equal dark cells and one cyan-selected state.
A centered independent four-stage event bar shows completion, active progress, result, and next states with matching chrome.
